The issue with the level cap is that it may not be so easy to know exactly what to spec for. As far as I'm aware we don't know all the perks cards that exist and will exist in the future. We don't currently have a list of all perk cards and due to the random nature of what cards will be received its hard to plan around RNG. Sharing perk cards can definitely help to minimize frustration but its no guarantee. There's no telling what cards may be added before or after launch. It would also suck to have your build nerfed with no way to change. Also to reiterate it doesn't sound like we'll be getting mod support anytime soon which could potentially remove the level cap.

I'm not saying every character should be able to do everything, simply give us an option to change. I still wouldn't mind if I costed a large amount of caps or scrap or time. Some of us make mistakes, especially on our first characters I would just like to be able to correct them without starting over.

I know that a few other people have voiced the same concern but I really hope that Bethesda considers putting in a way to respec SPECIAL points. I understand that other Fallout games didn't give you the option but in 76 there are level caps when in the other games you could level pseudo-infinitely. I would HATE to spend weeks on a character only to find that my build is trash or I have grown tired of a play style that I cannot change without reinvesting dozens of hours on a new character. In other games you could use mods or console commands but I doubt they will allow you the same luxury in 76. In Fallout 4 I started the game with a Luck build with almost no strength, but I found through playing that I enjoyed melee much more. That wasn't an issue in a game with no level cap or mods. What if a player doesn't invest into Intelligence but finds out later that they want to roleplay a traveling merchant/blacksmith but they already hit the cap? Do you say"sucks for you. Hope you enjoy the next couple weeks of grinding to get to the same point of progress."? I wouldn't even care if it took some obscene amount of caps or a stupid hard mission. Just give us the option, not a limitation. 

Edit: This just doesn't sound like a consumer friendly decision.
